justification: Assessment reported INVALID and targeted line 0051's claim that with 5 colors a non-conflicting color is always available regardless of the prior non-conflicting sequence -- precisely the flaw named in the ground truth. Its witness (wheel W5: rim colored with 5 distinct colors via legal non-conflicting moves, hub then sees all 5 colors and has no legal color) is a different but valid witness for the same claim: each rim move conflicts only with its already-colored consecutive neighbors, so the rainbow rim is a legal non-conflicting sequence, after which the hub's available-color set is empty. Same defect as the ground truth's icosahedron execution (a vertex whose 5 neighbors exhaust all 5 colors), so this counts as matching.
